name: MonarchDeltaIndicator
title: DeltaIndicator
summary: A change between two periods: a signed value, an optional arrow and an optional comparison, such as "+12% vs last month". The color follows which direction is better.
whenToUse: Next to a figure in a stat card, a table cell or a chart summary, to say how it moved since the previous period.
whenNotToUse: For a status that is not a change use MonarchBadge. For a trend over many periods use MonarchSparkline next to the figure.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDeltaIndicator(value: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, comparison: String? = null, goodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Up, variant: MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant = MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant.Plain, size: MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize = MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize.Sm, flatThreshold: Double = 0.0, icon: (@Composable (direction: MonarchDeltaIndicatorDirection) -> Unit)? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, flatLabel: String? = null, noDataLabel: String? = null, spokenLabel: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchDeltaIndicator(current: Double?, previous: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, comparison: String? = null, goodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Up, variant: MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant = MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant.Plain, size: MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize = MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize.Sm, flatThreshold: Double = 0.0, icon: (@Composable (direction: MonarchDeltaIndicatorDirection) -> Unit)? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, flatLabel: String? = null, noDataLabel: String? = null, spokenLabel: String? = null)
enum class MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection { Up, Down, Neither }
enum class MonarchDeltaIndicatorDirection { Up, Down, Flat }

options.name: value
options.description: The change. With the default writer a ratio: 0.12 is 12%. null, NaN or infinity means there is nothing to compare with.

options.name: current, previous
options.description: In the second overload: the two periods. The change is (current − previous) / |previous|; a previous value of 0 has no baseline.

options.name: comparison
options.description: The comparison period after the change, such as "vs last month". Shown muted and spoken.

options.name: goodDirection
options.description: Up, Down or Neither: which direction is an improvement.

options.name: variant
options.description: Plain is inline text; Subtle puts the change in a tinted pill.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm is the caption style, Md the label style.

options.name: flatThreshold
options.description: Changes whose size is at or below this count as no change.

options.name: icon
options.description: Draws the arrow for the direction, tinted with the tone color and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes the size of the change without a sign. The default is a percentage with at most one fraction digit in the current locale.

options.name: noDataLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in text "No earlier data" (monarch_deltaindicator_no_data).

options.name: spokenLabel
options.description: Replaces the whole sentence TalkBack reads.

states.name: better
states.description: A change in the good direction: the success color, a sign and "better" in the spoken sentence.

states.name: worse
states.description: A change in the other direction: the danger color, a sign and "worse" in the spoken sentence.

states.name: neutral
states.description: goodDirection is Neither: muted text and a sign.

states.name: no change
states.description: Zero, inside flatThreshold, or written the same as zero: "No change" in the muted color.

states.name: no data
states.description: null or not finite: "No earlier data", with no arrow and no comparison.

appearance: Plain draws the change in the strong color of its tone (success strong, danger strong, or muted text for neutral) and the comparison in muted text. Subtle puts the change in a fully rounded pill with the tone's subtle background and strong text. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web formats percentages, numbers with a unit and currencies from options; here the default is a percentage in the current locale and formatValue takes a function for anything else, as on iOS. The web appearance values plain and pill are the variants Plain and Subtle. The web draws its own arrow; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the arrow is an optional slot that receives the direction, and without it the sign and the spoken words carry the direction. The web lets each spoken word be replaced; here the words are string resources (monarch_deltaindicator_*) that an app can translate, and spokenLabel replaces the whole sentence. The current and previous overload always gives a ratio.
accessibility: The indicator is one element whose content description is a sentence: "up 12% vs last month, better".
Better and worse are spoken, and the visible change has a sign, so nothing depends on color.
A decrease is written with a real minus sign (U+2212).
The icon slot is decoration and is not read.
The indicator has no click action and no touch target.
Digits use tabular figures, and a long comparison wraps inside the available width at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A change that the writer writes the same as zero, such as 0.00001 as a percentage, is "No change", never "+0%".
With current and previous, a previous value of zero has no baseline and shows "No earlier data".
A negative baseline uses its absolute value, so −100 to −50 is an increase of 50%.
The comparison is not shown when there is no data.

examples.title: Better, worse and lower-is-better
Lower is better, written in milliseconds
examples.code:
MonarchDeltaIndicator(
    value = -42.0,
    goodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Down,
    variant = MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant.Subtle,
    formatValue = { "${it.toInt()} ms" },
)

examples.title: From two periods, with an arrow
examples.code:
MonarchDeltaIndicator(
    current = 120.0,
    previous = 100.0,
    comparison = "vs last week",
    size = MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize.Md,
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ArrowUp, contentDescription = null) },
)
